name: Okamura Foods Co., Ltd.
summary: Okamura Foods Co., Ltd. farms, produces, and sells salmon seafood products in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Aquaculture Business, Domestic Processing Business, Overseas Processing Business, and Overseas Wholesale Business segments. It also sells salmon farming and adult fish in Aomori and Denmark; process and sells salmon roe, fish roe, seafood, and mackerel. In addition, the company processes and sells herring roe and cod roe, as well as salmon roe, salmon sushi toppings for raw consumption, grilled fish, and boiled fish. In addition, the company wholesales products. Okamura Foods Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1971 and is headquartered in Aomori, Japan.
